name: Elhanan
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: There were further battles at Gob and at Gath. Sibbechai slew Sippai, Elhanan slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam, and Jonathan the son of Shimeah, David's brother, slew a man of great stature with six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot. These four were born to the giant in Gath and fell by the hand of David and his servants.

note.label: 2 Samuel 21: The Famine, the Gibeonites, and the Sons of the Giant

points: In another battle Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 20: The Fall of Rabbah and the Giants
